reels.title: AI Startup Credits 2026: Up to $100K in Model & Compute Grants Without VC

editorial_notes.reasoning: This topic offers the highest strategic value by aggregating multiple ecosystem incentives into a 'stacking' narrative. It appeals to the developer/founder segment while allowing for a sophisticated, high-velocity visualization of resource optimization.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if you could run a billion-dollar AI engine for free just by knowing how to stack your credits?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: The 'Digital Buffet' strategy: treating disparate API credits like stacking coupons at a grocery store to maximize your purchasing power for a project.
